full_judgment: 4. The defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filling a written statement. His case in brief was that he took settlement of the land of S.A. Khatian Nos. 165, 167 and 168 from the defendant no.15, Ushabala Chakraborty in Baisakh, 1354 B S. and since then he has been possessing the same. He auction purchased the lands of S. A. Khatian No. 169 on 21. 12. 62 in Certificate Case No. 60/ K 1961 62 and thereafter took possession of the same through Court and since then he has been in possession of the same. Thus the defendant No.1 is the owner and possessor of the suit land. The sole decree, dated 16.4 70 passed in Title Suit No. 109 of 1970 and the auction sale held on 21. 12. 62 on Certificate Case No. 60K/ 61-e2 are quite legal and valid. The notices and the sale proclamation were duly issued and served in the Certificate Case. The summons were also duly served upon the defendants of Title Suit No. 109 of 1970. The defendants of the suit duly signed the solenama which is a genuine document. The plaintiff and his brother, the defendant No 22, never acquired any title or possession in the suit land. The suit is not maintainable in the present form. The plaintiff has no locus-stand to file the suit; the suit is liable to be dismissed.
